name: research/clean_pool_identity_pairs.py:TOL
justification: Floating-point equality of daily log returns (1e-9): identical series differ only by float rounding.

name: research/cointegration_estimator_arms.py:DOLS_LEADS_LAGS
justification: Stock-Watson (1993) DOLS uses a small fixed number of leads/lags of the differenced regressor; k = 2 removes the endogeneity bias on synthetic data (mean |beta error| 0.058 -> 0.028).

name: research/cointegration_estimator_arms.py:JOHANSEN_CRIT_REPS
justification: Simulation draws for the 95% quantile of the null trace statistic; 4,000 gives a Monte Carlo error well below the gap between the simulated value (~20.2-20.5) and a test statistic near it; size verified 0.050.

name: research/identify_wrds_files.py:MATCH_SHARE
justification: Share of days a candidate's CRSP return must match the file's. Scores are bimodal: of 823 candidate scores none lies in [0.4, 0.9); thresholds 0.5-0.9 give the identical 767 matches (0.95 gives 766).

name: research/identify_wrds_files.py:MATCH_TOL
justification: Daily return equality tolerance (1e-3 = 0.1%): CRSP dlyret vs the file's close-to-close return of the same security differ only by rounding of adjusted prices; different securities differ by far more on most days.

name: research/identify_wrds_files.py:MIN_DAYS
justification: Minimum overlapping days for a share to be computed (15, i.e. 3 trading weeks); below it the label is 'unresolved_untestable', never guessed.

name: research/identify_wrds_files.py:TOL_DAYS
justification: Same +-10 day listing-date tolerance as the D17 relabel (first trade can lag the names-table date by days); kept identical so the two identifications are comparable.

name: research/identify_wrds_files.py:WINDOW_DAYS
justification: +-45 calendar days around each of three dates (~60 trading days each) bounds the WRDS query size; identity is decided by the bimodal share, insensitive to window length.

name: research/inclusion_did.py:BAND_BARS
justification: One month of trading days excluded on each side of the inclusion date: announcement-to-effective trading and index-rebalance flows are not co-movement.

name: research/inclusion_did.py:N_BOOT
justification: Bootstrap draws over events for the 95% percentile CI; >= 1,000 is the usual minimum for percentile intervals (Efron & Tibshirani 1993); 2,000 halves the Monte Carlo error at modest cost.

name: research/inclusion_did.py:N_CONTROLS
justification: Matched controls per event (nearest size, same SIC2); averaging 3 cuts control noise ~3x while keeping matches close. Sensitivity with 1 and 5 controls to be reported beside the result.

name: research/inclusion_did.py:N_MEMBERS
justification: Incumbent members sampled per event for the mean correlation; the mean of 50 correlations has small sampling error relative to the effects measured, at bounded compute.

name: research/inclusion_did.py:PRETREND_BINS
justification: One bin per calendar month of the 12-month pre-inclusion period (was 5 with no reason; changed 2026-10-14). Size verified over 1,200 seeds: 4.5% / 6.7%.

name: research/inclusion_did.py:PRE_BARS
justification: One year of trading days on each side of inclusion (the 12-month pre/post windows of Barberis-Shleifer-Wurgler 2005).

name: research/inclusion_did.py:SIGNFLIP_DRAWS
justification: Sign-flip randomization draws; Monte Carlo error of a p-value near 0.05 is ~0.003 with 5,000 draws.

name: research/split_level_breaks.py:LEVEL_BREAK_FACTOR
justification: One-day move above which a Compustat Global total-return series is split: the 2026-10-14 audit threshold (698 series; qunit explains 103). Approved by Ross 2026-10-15; results to be checked at 3x and 10x.

name: research/split_level_breaks.py:REVERT_DAYS
justification: A bad print must revert within one trading week to be masked rather than split.

name: research/split_level_breaks.py:REVERT_TOL
justification: |log| distance from the pre-jump level that counts as reverted (0.5 = within ~1.6x), loose enough for an intervening real move, far below the 5x break.

name: research/inclusion_did.py:WINDOW_MARGIN_DAYS
justification: Calendar slack added to the PRE_BARS-in-calendar-days exclusion window so a holiday week cannot let a stock with an S&P 500 spell at the window edge in as a control; only widens the exclusion (conservative).

name: research/inclusion_did.py:RUNUP_SHORTLIST
justification: Run-up variant considers the 10 x N_CONTROLS size-nearest candidates so the run-up match stays close in size; sensitivity at other values not yet run (disclosed).
